title: Local inline GIF renderer manifest, physical screen pixels

ownerHwnd.description: Top-level chat HWND as decimal string or 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string. Per-item override is supported.

ownerProcessId.description: Expected owner PID; strongly recommended to reject stale/recycled handles.

source.description: Absolute local GIF file. URLs, UNC paths, and drive-relative paths are rejected. Parent supplies extracted original bytes; renderer performs no network access.

backgroundArgb.description: Optional backing color. Supply the correct opaque #AARRGGBB canvas color for transparent GIFs to cover the original static thumbnail; omitted uses transparency.
